provenance.notes: The real first lifecycle event (index 0, event_type 0 = created) of the passport pallet's own live testnet worked example, at key (DOCS-EXAMPLE-0001, 00000000000017). Named 'minimal' because every LifecycleEventV1 encodes to the same fixed 41 bytes regardless of field values, so this and 'typical' differ only in content, not in shape or length.
